question: Should OpenClaw accept `safetyDiagnostics.emit` plus manifest `safetyEventTypes` as a permanent plugin SDK contract and keep durable operator-facing safety history in core?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin capability and persistent operator surface, not a mechanical repair; the open canonical request is already marked for product and security review.

options.title: Sponsor and narrow the contract
options.body: Approve the core direction, document the intended plugin and data boundary, and require authoritative session IDs plus final-head behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the core seam smaller
options.body: Retain only a narrowly approved internal diagnostics seam and move optional plugin emission or dashboard behavior to owner plugins.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether this observability taxonomy belongs in core rather than an external plugin/ClawHub path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, document the intended plugin and data boundary, and require authoritative session IDs plus final-head behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical proposal and the active implementation series, but a repository owner should make the final product decision.
